text:
emma.sales: heads up  POC stuck for ClearSupply (tenant clear-supply-poc). Okta shows provisioning success (204) but tenant has no users. SAML NameID value looks like a session token (_sess_6789) and their Okta SCIM connector is using the onboarding api key in Authorization. cc @lucas.engineer @priya.se
lucas.engineer: ok that's two likely problems: NameID must be email or include an email attribute; and SCIM needs the scim service token (hosted keys don't work for /scim). can you get a screenshot of the Okta provisioning mapping?
emma.sales: attached: externalId = app.group.id, userName = user.id. Okta admin says group push returns 204. tenant id clear-supply-poc.
priya.se: externalId mapped to group.id will cause duplicate collisions on group push -> our SCIM returns 409 and Okta still shows 204. also if they used onboarding_key in Authorization our endpoint will return 401. ask them to check whether a corporate proxy rewrites headers; that often causes intermittent 403s.
ben.ops: i checked logs: we saw a 409 duplicate for externalId=group_17 at 1961240060 and a 401 at 1961240110 (token invalid for scim). idp-bot also logged a push failure. two actions: 1) we will issue a scoped SCIM token and a short-lived inference key for their Dedicated perf run; 2) customer must change mappings to user.login or user.email and set SAML NameID to emailAddress.
sec-bot: security reminder: for Private/VPC trials we may require traffic from allowed IPs or mTLS. For hosted trials bearer scim tokens are okay but must be DM'd to the designated admin and rotated. do not paste secrets in screenshots.
emma.sales: customer asked if we can create a temp hosted key so they can run a 1-hr throughput test while they fix provisioning. they want the test to target pool 'dedicated-clear-1'.
ben.ops: i can create two scoped creds: scim_clear_tmp_48h (scopes: scim:write,scim:read) expiring in 48h and tmp_infer_clear_1h (scopes: inference:generate) restricted to pool dedicated-clear-1, expires in 3600s. will DM secrets to Emma only. annotation: rotate on expiry.
lucas.engineer: when they swap the token and update the mapping have them run this curl from inside their network to validate SCIM auth and content-type:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer SCIM_CLEAR_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  https://scim.redwood-inference.example.com/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
```
priya.se: SAML guidance for Okta admin: set NameID Format to urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress or map attribute `email` into the assertion. sample snippet sent in DM. also map groups -> teams if they want role sync.
emma.sales: forwarding the two tokens via DM now and sending Okta mapping steps. i'll ask them to re-run group push and capture raw req/resp if Okta still shows 204 but no users.
idp-bot: SCIM webhook from okta.clearsupply.example.com -> /scim/v2/Users returned 409 at 1961240060 (duplicate externalId=group_17)
ben.ops: tokens created: scim_clear_tmp_48h (expires=1961426399), tmp_infer_clear_1h (expires=1961243599). DM'd secrets to Emma. please confirm when they re-run the push and whether users appear.
emma.sales: received, sent to ClearSupply admin. asked them not to paste tokens in tickets and to re-run group push. will update thread with results. thanks everyone :pray:
